reviews.review:
Is this game good?
Really depends on the price point.
At the current price of £6 I would say its a yes its worth it for that price its a decent top down shooter with different classes skills,  random on map upgrades and crafting.

You can call in support weapons and structures.

Graphics, animations and enemies are all ok.
Sound is pretty decent.
Missions are samey.

Buuuttttt is £6 for crying out loud - its cheaper than the £7 they charge ate the cinema for popcorn.....
